fix_audit.summary: ALL 14 r1 findings (1B/6W/7N incl. the advisory gate) verified FIXED against the worktree @ 1b96bea. Every classification re-derived from the code, not the minion's claims.

items.title: M-key mute chain dead
items.proof: poll.odin:61 emits Key_Press{.M}; mouse.odin phase-1 collects .M (keys [4]->[5]Key — P/Space coalesce so 5 is an exact fit) + 'case .M: append(out, Intent(Toggle_Mute{}))' (Perkins' prescribed shape); types.odin Key.M + Toggle_Mute in the Intent union; exec.odin case Toggle_Mute -> on_mute; input.odin on_mute field; main.odin:269 on_mute = effect_mute -> au.toggle_mute; toggle_mute flips Audio.muted + StopSounds; audio_flush drops staged plays while muted; consumer sets captions regardless of mute (captions stay live); HUD shows caption else the 'audio muted - press M' pill. Chain ALIVE end-to-end.

items.title: caption clobber (last-writer-wins)
items.proof: arrival branch guards on caption_crisis_live (live && crisis && tick <= until_tick) — an unexpired crisis caption is never clobbered by an arrival; same-tick ordering (arrivals before crises in core/step.odin) keeps the crisis winning; unit test test_caption_crisis_priority pins same-batch win, in-dwell protection, post-expiry handoff.

items.title: captions zero coverage
items.proof: test_caption_crisis_priority + test_caption_expiry_and_reset (text, dwell live-at-end, expiry at until+1, reset clears caption + throttle). odin test app/audio 7/7 PASS at the sha (Perkins-run).

items.title: vacuous-guard counts totals only
items.proof: crisis_draws/arrival_draws counters + harness/run.odin:465-471 assert BOTH >= 1 for audio.dem; strictly stronger than the r1 total-draws guard. Gate 4 green (31 demos).

items.title: arrival throttle unasserted
items.proof: demos/audio_throttle.dem (new — wide path + express-lane burst ticks 11/12/13) + harness asserts arrival_draws >= 1 AND suppressed != 0 (run.odin:472-476); unit test pins 4-event burst -> 2 plays / 2 suppressed. Gate 4 green (ticks=80 = 4000ms @ 20Hz).

findings.title: The 7 new app/audio unit tests run in NO gate — ci-local.sh and ci.yml execute only `odin test core`
findings.evidence: "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|odin test core" (ci-local.sh GATES); `run: odin test core` (ci.yml:70); no `odin test app/audio` in any gate/script/workflow step (grep-verified).
findings.detail: The r1 W2/W5 fold deliverable is real and passes (Perkins ran it: 7/7) but is ornamental in automation — nothing runs or even compiles audio_test.odin in a gate, so caption-priority/wav_pack/throttle-arithmetic regressions fail no gate unless they perturb a golden. Demoted from the tests lens's blocker, consistent with r1's re-triage precedent: the ODN-15 determinism spine (the one blocker class) is 100% gate-pinned incl. the new per-kind guards; this is a durability/rigor gap, not a correctness defect at the reviewed sha.
findings.recommended_fix: Add `odin test app/audio` to gate 2 in tools/ci-local.sh AND .github/workflows/ci.yml (the mirror rule — never edit one without the other); check the container leg links the stock raylib for the test target (the rlsw shadow story).

findings.title: The r1-B1 M-mute chain has zero automated coverage — no scripted .M anywhere; mute on/off boundary untested
findings.evidence: grep for a scripted `Key_Press{key = .M}` across harness/*.odin and app/audio/audio_test.odin returns nothing; none of the 7 unit tests calls toggle_mute.
findings.detail: r1's blocker was this exact chain dying silently (poll emitted .M, no mapper collected it). The r2 fix re-wires it correctly (Perkins traced every link), but no test pins any link — the parity pattern that catches dropped key paths is not applied to .M, so the r1 bug class can regress silently. Rigor gap, not a defect at this sha.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a parity leg scripting Key_Press{.M} with a stub on_mute asserting the Toggle_Mute intent fires, and/or a zero-Audio unit test toggling mute both ways (device_on=false -> toggle_mute makes no rl calls).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: Re-derived by Perkins after verification: P0 (ODN-15 determinism neutrality) = 100% AND gate-pinned (per-kind vacuous-guards, no-consumer replay gate, 31-demo suite green at the sha). P1: caption/expiry/reset pins exist but are UNGATED (W1); the M-mute chain is manual-only (W2); asset error paths manual (N8). The lens's mechanical FAIL (P1 <80%) was driven by the ungated-but-passing pure-logic pins; re-triaged to CONCERNS per the r1 precedent.
findings.recommended_fix: Wire `odin test app/audio` into gate 2 (ci-local.sh + ci.yml) and add one scripted-.M pin — raises the gate to PASS.

findings.title: Throttle cold-start: arrival_last_tick=0 doubles as 'clicked at tick 0' — a first arrival at tick 0/1 is suppressed with no prior click
findings.evidence: `if e.tick < a.arrival_last_tick + ARRIVAL_MIN_GAP_TICKS { a.suppressed += 1; continue }` with `a.arrival_last_tick = 0` at init/reset.
findings.detail: Ticks 0/1 of a fresh run satisfy e.tick < 0+2 and are silenced + counted in `suppressed` (the W4 guard's metric) with no genuine bite. Unreachable in practice (runs start on an empty map; demos spawn at tick >=2 and travel is >=1 tick/edge; the audio_throttle golden's first arrivals are ~tick 13) — a latent boundary impurity, not a live defect.
findings.recommended_fix: Sentinel the never-clicked state (max(u64) or a has_clicked bool, reset in audio_reset_run) so a run's first arrival always plays; reserve `suppressed` for genuine throttle bites.

findings.title: Incomplete W6 fold: code comments still source the SFX slots from Suno, contradicting the FINAL ruling (SFX = ElevenLabs) the README + PR body carry
findings.evidence: audio.odin:19 `// Asset-drop contract (see assets/audio/README.md): drop Suno files at`; audio.odin:254 `// ... dropping a Suno`; main.odin:204 `// (real Suno assets when present, ...`.
findings.detail: The r1-W6 fold fixed the supplier story in the README + PR body but missed the module's own comments — five sites still tell a reader to drop Suno files into the SFX slots (Suno = music only per the settled ruling). Same wrong-supplier trail, new locations.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword the Suno mentions in audio.odin (6, 19, 52, 254) + main.odin:204 to name ElevenLabs for the SFX slots (or point at assets/audio/README.md as the single source).

findings.title: Stale vacuous-guard descriptions after the W3 fold (a 'draws>0 check' that no longer exists; the `draws` field's stated purpose gone)
findings.evidence: run.odin:308 `// ... The draws>0 check (after the loop) is the vacuous-guard`; audio.odin:95 `draws: u64, // cosmetic draws so far (the harness's vacuous-guard)` — the harness reads crisis_draws/arrival_draws/suppressed, never `draws` (grep-verified).
findings.detail: The W3 fold replaced the total-draws guard with per-kind counters but left the old descriptions; a reader hunting the 'draws>0 check' finds nothing. The per-kind guards are strictly stronger — only the words are stale.
findings.recommended_fix: Update run.odin:308-309 to describe the per-kind/suppressed guards; reword audio.odin:95 (total draws is now unit-test telemetry).

findings.title: PR body acceptance §2 still describes the r1 vacuous-guard (draws > 0, one golden) — stale vs the r2 per-kind guards and the added audio_throttle golden
findings.evidence: `A `draws > 0` vacuous-guard fails the demo if the consumer never drew` (pr-body.md:27) vs harness/run.odin:463-478 (per-kind + suppressed, two demos).
findings.detail: The body's r2 rework section carries the truth (W3 per-kind, W4 audio_throttle) but the acceptance paragraph it supersedes was never updated — the body's own sections disagree.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword acceptance §2 to name the per-kind minimums + the audio_throttle.dem golden (mirror the body's rework bullets).

findings.title: Harness audio-consumer activation is keyed on hardcoded demo names, not a demo directive — a future audio golden added without editing run.odin runs vacuous
findings.evidence: `audio_consumer_on := name == "audio" || name == "audio_throttle"` (the per-kind guards at :463 share the same gate).
findings.detail: Every other run-setup behavior rides the demo file (fixture, era, spawns, captures). Name-keying means a third audio golden added without a run.odin edit runs with no consumer AND no vacuous-guards — silently reintroducing the r1 W3/W4 vacuous-golden failure mode. Today's two goldens are wired + guarded + green; this is rot-resistance.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a demo directive (e.g. `audio on`) parsed like `fixture off`, and key the consumer + per-kind guards on it, so audio goldens are self-describing.

findings.title: Caption struct comment claims `text` is always a view into `buf`, but arrival captions assign a string literal
findings.evidence: `text: string, // ... a view into `buf`` vs `set_caption(&a.caption, "packet delivered", e.tick, false)`.
findings.detail: Harmless today (string literals are static, outliving any buf), but the stated invariant is false for the arrival path — future code trusting the aliasing breaks.
findings.recommended_fix: Fix the comment (text is a buf view for crisis captions only) or copy the arrival literal into buf.

findings.title: audio_destroy unloads sounds only when device_on but closes the device unconditionally — verified harmless (raylib no-ops)
findings.detail: When InitAudioDevice fails (headless silent-fallback), CloseAudioDevice runs against a never-opened device. Verified against the vendored raylib 6.0 source (raudio.c:531-543): CloseAudioDevice is isReady-guarded and no-ops. Teardown asymmetry only — zero functional impact.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: move rl.CloseAudioDevice() inside the device_on block so teardown mirrors the initialized state.

findings.title: Asset-fallback error paths manual-only: the corrupt-file UnloadSound branch and the device-absent fallback have no automated coverage
findings.evidence: audio_test.odin tests only the device-free happy paths (synth forms, wav_pack); load_variant's rl-gated branches are untestable in the pure suite.
findings.detail: The r1 recommendation explicitly allowed 'document the corrupt-file path as manually verified' — the PR body documents the app smoke + the UnloadSound'd decode path. Accepted residual; P2/P3-class gap.
findings.recommended_fix: If durability is wanted, factor slot resolution into a pure decision helper and unit-test that.

findings.title: The new flush variant-cycle for multi-play batches is untested
findings.evidence: `v := (a.pending.crisis_variant + i32(k)) % CRISIS_VARIANTS` — no test exercises the cycle (rl-gated flush; the index math is pure).
findings.detail: Math verified safe by Perkins (base in [0,2], k < plays <= 65535 as i32, Odin % on non-negatives -> [0,2] — in-bounds, no panic path). Untested but trivially correct; a pure helper would make it pinnable.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract cycle_variant(base, k, n) and unit-test it, or add a multi-play flush line to the manual smoke checklist.

rejected.title: rng_range upper bound unpinned (variant slot 3 possibly unreachable)
rejected.reason: REJECTED — core/rng.odin:66-71's inclusive-hi contract was verified at r1 and is settled ground; the claimed risk does not exist. Variant draws are in-bounds by construction.

rejected.title: catch-up frames birth captions pre-expired (event-tick stamp vs app-tick query)
rejected.reason: REJECTED — impossible by construction: main.odin:298-349 bounds a consume batch to max_steps=5 ticks (dt clamped to 0.25s, debt to 1 tick), so a caption's age at draw is <=5 ticks << the 40-tick dwell. The >=40-tick catch-up the finding requires cannot occur.
